skills.name: rtk
skills.description: rtk (Rust Token Killer) 1.0.1, default pipeline: a PreToolUse hook rewrites Bash commands such as ls and cat to rtk equivalents that compress their output. Claims 60-90% fewer tokens on common dev commands.

skills.name: headroom
skills.description: Headroom 0.41.0 in proxy mode: compresses tool outputs, logs and files in each request before it reaches the model. Claims 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% for JSON.

skills.name: caveman
skills.description: caveman 4.0.1 as its Claude Code plugin: a SessionStart hook turns on a terse 'caveman' reply voice for the whole session; code, commands and errors stay verbatim. Claims 65% fewer tokens (repo description).

skills.name: control
skills.description: Changes nothing. Checks the method: it should come out 'same cost'.
